title: Momoi Airi — Many Feelings Delivered〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Us appearing on TV, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I told everyone that we should sleep on it before making a decision, so I should probably step back to reevaluate our situation...)
Airi, wait!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Shizuku?
I thought you were going to archery club today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was, but I decided not to go because I wanted to use that time to think about us appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked for a bit on our way home, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course I wouldn't.
I mean, this problem involves all of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Airi, you're for us making this appearance, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Like I said when we were on the rooftop, I feel that the benefits far outweigh the costs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I think hashing out all the good and bad regarding the media is really important...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka doesn't seem to have much experience with that, which may be why she's so apprehensive.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm actually a little worried about how they're going to introduce and present Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, after putting on our solo show, I doubt they're gonna label her an “amateur” or anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, there really is a lot that we need to consider...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, there is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, did you ever meet the old director for The Wide World of Laughs? He worked on a music variety show after that, so I'm pretty sure that you have, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I remember, but I don't understand what he has to do with our current situation...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, when I appeared on his show with QT, they really surprised us with the way they edited everything. Our agency couldn't believe it either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did a tongue twister game for one segment, and I didn't make any mistakes as they began throwing some curveballs at me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, they challenged me with a tongue twister that even some announcers have trouble saying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was doing just fine until then, but I got so mixed up that it sounded like I was casting a spell for something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, that's pretty common for TV, right? Someone boasts that a task is gonna be a piece of cake and they end up failing miserably.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
That seems fairly standard for variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or so you'd think...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I saw it on TV, they'd completely left out the part where I did well and only kept the part where I totally messed up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Left out...? They cut all of it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. They even left in the talk portions that didn't have to do with the tongue twisters, so I've gotta think what they did was intentional.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the time, neither our group nor our agency could figure out why they edited the show that way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, I learned something when we were asked to make another appearance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The program was meant to be about challenges, but as it turns out, he wanted to feature people who made mistakes or just barely managed to succeed over the ones who didn't have any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In theory, that makes for a more fun and interesting program...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it became clear that he wanted to shine the spotlight on those who were trying their very best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, he always made sure to praise new members and tell them how good of a job they did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. And he was someone who really paid attention to people who went the extra mile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: While some people may ask you to do crazy things, there are also those who pick up on what you want others to see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I didn't mean to surprise you with this story.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My opinion is based on my own lived experience, Shizuku, so you have to come up with your own, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, your story reminded me of when I appeared on this one program a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Go on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After talking about this with you, Shizuku, I kinda want to go back and watch all our old shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to get back in the groove of all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to as well.
I hope we still have the recordings...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I particularly would like to see that tongue twister game you mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, but...
Wait, you just want to see the part where I mess up, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Airi.
You know me too well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hah, that's cute.
You're not gonna fool me so easily.
